context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: スニーカー/きゅうり/太く/ねじ/子守/鈍感/包む/乗り場

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、スニーカー、絶対、ママ、絶対、買ってあげるね
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — I'll absolutely buy you new sneakers, okay?
lines.style: Warm, reassuring tone. Gentle emphasis on the promise, not the repetition. Mother's voice carrying both sincerity and affection. Open, inviting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、きゅうり、絶対、ぼく、絶対、収穫してきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I really did it — I harvested cucumbers from the garden all by myself!
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick tempo on the opening. Small chest puff in the voice. Eyes up — wanting her to see what he's done. Genuine accomplishment, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの腕、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、太く、絶対、なってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Dad's arms have gotten really thick lately, Sho.
lines.style: Observational, half-amused. Soft chuckle beneath the words. Not quite directed at him — more thinking out loud. Warm but slightly distant, like noticing something in passing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、椅子の、絶対、ねじ、絶対、緩んでるよ
lines.en: The chair's screw is loose, Mom.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, problem-solver's tone. No fanfare. Simple statement of fact. He's noticed it and he's telling her — that's all. Practical kindness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんが、本気で、絶対、子守、絶対、引き受けてくれることになったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandmother's agreed to babysit, Sho.
lines.style: Calm announcement. Gentle contentment in the delivery. A small relief settling into her voice. Not excited — settled. This is good news delivered with quiet relief.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、鈍感、絶対、なところ、絶対、あるかも
lines.en: I might actually be a little bit oblivious sometimes, Mom.
lines.style: Self-aware, wry half-smile in the voice. Slow, thoughtful delivery on this one — he's noticing something true about himself and naming it gently. No self-pity, just recognition.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お弁当、本気で、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、包む、絶対、と、絶対、嬉しいわよね、翔くん
lines.en: When you wrap my lunchbox so carefully, it makes me happy, you know?
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Tender but not clingy. He's noticed the care and he's saying thank you for it. Warm, present moment. No embarrassment — just love stated simply.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: バスの、本気で、絶対、乗り場、絶対、駅前で、絶対、迷っちゃったよ、ママ
lines.en: Mom, I got lost at the bus stop in front of the station.
lines.style: Quiet confession. Slight hesitation on the opening — checking whether this will worry her. Small voice, but honest. The vulnerability of a child admitting he was lost, needing her to know.
